title: Synchronous-ROM read through multi-hop alias chain into clocked sample register
sourceUrl: internal: Kmila DeltaCycleEngine convergence regression test (handoff 2026-06-21 §5)
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Mirrors SourceElaborator's output for a top entity wiring ROM (output port) -> parent signal -> CPU (input port). Inside the parent arch: ROM process drives an internal signal U_ROM__data_out conditionally on enable+rising_edge; two concurrent assignments (rom_data_w <= U_ROM__data_out; U_CPU__rom_data <= rom_data_w) form the alias chain; the CPU process is a small state machine that issues an address, waits one cycle for the synchronous ROM, then samples U_CPU__rom_data into acc_reg. GHDL: acc_out settles at 0xDD (rom[3]). Locks in P2A's exact shape as a regression case.
